item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Monday, May 25th, 2026! It's currently a mild 16°C with a light drizzle kissing Sydney this morning, but it feels a touch warmer at 18°C as we greet the new week. Today, let's remember that every sunrise brings a chance to be the architect of our own joy; as the day unfolds towards a top of 21°C, and with a 79% chance of more rain, grab that umbrella before you head out! Make today count, embrace the opportunities, and have an absolutely fantastic day!
